title: Lightning Strike Jutsu
body:
Syntax: perform lightning strike jutsu <target>

Description: A Ninjutsu jutsu, unlocked at level 20. 24-29 damage, with a 30% chance to also Paralyze the target -- completely unable to act for their next couple of rounds. Costs 22 Chakra, 6 second cooldown.

Requires your own chakra nature (primary or secondary) to genuinely be Lightning -- this jutsu cannot be cast at all otherwise, even if it shows up in your learned skills.

Date: 2026-08-24
